corpus.selection: Prose paragraphs (>=12 words, no tables or code) from docs/engineering/*.md at the commit, at most 96 words and 128 tokenizer tokens; every fifth sorted file is held out; first-paragraph-index order, then path.

design.held_out: Token-weighted mean loss on held-out files, FP32 mlx_lm forward pass of a freshly loaded model with the trained adapters.
design.peak_allocated: Max over window steps of mx.get_peak_memory() after mx.reset_peak_memory() before each step: process-wide MLX active bytes, including resident weights.
design.scope: One Apple GPU on this host. No other GPU, vendor or framework is measured, and no comparison with any other product is made.
design.tokens: Supervised next-token pairs; padding and packing boundary positions are excluded.

unavailable_reasons.not_exposed_by_mlx: MLX 0.32.3 exposes active, peak-active and current cache bytes, but no peak reserved-pool or GPU utilization counter, and macOS GPU busy time is not sampled. No value is estimated.

design.wall_time: perf_counter around the whole window (batch construction, forward, backward, optimizer update, synchronizing evaluation).
design.window: Identical samples and supervised tokens in every configuration; the one-sample-per-step reference uses eight times the steps.
